camel_example: aliyun iot ResetThing --region cn-hangzhou --IotId SR8FiTu1R9tlUR2V1bmi0010a50000 --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --ProductKey a1KiV000000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Resets a specified device, resets the unique-certificate-per-product authentication status of a directly connected device, and deletes the topology of the device
description_zh: 重置指定设备，重置直连设备一型一密状态，同时删除当前设备的拓扑关系
kebab_example: aliyun iot reset-thing --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1KiV000000 --device-name device1 --iot-id SR8FiTu1R9tlUR2V1bmi0010a50000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetThing

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device that you want to reset belongs.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要重置的设备所属的产品ProductKey。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device that you want to reset.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
指定重置的设备的名称。

如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to reset.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要重置的设备ID。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，与ProductKey和DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

JobId.description_zh: 设备任务ID，设备任务的全局唯一标识符

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
